backup.production_rule: Record a booking made outside the site (phase 1). 20261211000000 adds booking_inquiries.channel (text, not null, default site, check: site, messenger, facebook, walk_in, phone, other), the function record_offline_booking_v1 (signed-in owners and admins only, 17 arguments, returns jsonb) and ONE added predicate in decide_direct_booking_without_finance_review(uuid,text,text): an Airbnb blocked row labelled direct no longer conflicts when the transaction setting cascade.offline_booking_id equals the booking id and the block note names the booking reference. Without that setting (every site confirm) the engine behaves as before. The migration stops (55000) unless the engine body is the one it was cut from (md5 8f9384913791779afd0cd38ed5152220, carriage returns removed) and re-hashes the patched body (2342d3f0ee88eb5f98c1260577391618). Nothing is granted to anon or service_role. The function relabels overlapping Airbnb blocks to direct (note DIR <ref> confirmed), writes the hold, the booking, the income row (pending_review, full total at check-in) and the optional Messenger thread link, then confirms through the one-tap core; any refusal rolls the whole sub-block back.
backup.notes: restore_point and verified_at are placeholders: restamp them with a fresh backup at apply time (scripts/migrations/fill-restore-point.mjs). The migration carries no begin/commit (the runner wraps it); the rollback carries its own and refuses (55000) once a booking carries a channel other than site. Before apply, read the live engine md5 (read-only) and compare it with 8f9384913791779afd0cd38ed5152220. Apply the SQL before the Staff release that calls the function.

forward_verification.name: channel_column_and_check
forward_verification.query: select exists (select 1 from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'booking_inquiries' and column_name = 'channel' and is_nullable = 'NO' and column_default like '%site%') and exists (select 1 from pg_constraint where conrelid = 'public.booking_inquiries'::regclass and conname = 'booking_inquiries_channel_check')

forward_verification.name: engine_has_the_patched_body
forward_verification.query: select md5(replace(prosrc, chr(13), '')) = '2342d3f0ee88eb5f98c1260577391618' from pg_proc where oid = 'public.decide_direct_booking_without_finance_review(uuid,text,text)'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: function_for_signed_in_users_only
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.record_offline_booking_v1(uuid,date,date,text,text,text,text,integer,numeric,numeric,text,text,text,text,boolean,text[],text)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.record_offline_booking_v1(uuid,date,date,text,text,text,text,integer,numeric,numeric,text,text,text,text,boolean,text[],text)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.record_offline_booking_v1(uuid,date,date,text,text,text,text,integer,numeric,numeric,text,text,text,text,boolean,text[],text)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: engine_reachable_by_nobody
forward_verification.query: select not has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.decide_direct_booking_without_finance_review(uuid,text,text)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.decide_direct_booking_without_finance_review(uuid,text,text)', 'execute') and not has_function_privilege('service_role', 'public.decide_direct_booking_without_finance_review(uuid,text,text)', 'execute')

forward_verification.name: every_existing_booking_is_channel_site
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from public.booking_inquiries where channel <> 'site')

rollback.safe_until: until a booking carries a channel other than site (the rollback refuses with 55000 rather than lose where it came from)

steps.name: restore_engine_and_drop_additions
steps.action: apply supabase/rollbacks/20261211_record_offline_booking.sql with run-sql-on-host.sh (takes the one predicate out of the engine, md5 back to 8f9384913791779afd0cd38ed5152220, drops record_offline_booking_v1, the channel check and the channel column). Bookings already recorded stay as confirmed direct bookings; the Airbnb blocks relabelled direct stay so (calendar-sync resets them after a cancel).

feature_flags.name: staff_app_release_follows_the_sql
feature_flags.required_state: Apply this SQL first; the Staff release that calls record_offline_booking_v1 goes second. Nothing calls the function until then, and existing readers ignore the new channel column.

compatibility.evidence: Not rehearsed: lane A had no runnable local Postgres with Supabase schemas (no Docker, no pgTAP in WSL). The md5 guard simulation (scripts/ci/check-md5-guards.mjs) runs here; the pgTAP suite supabase/tests/database/record_offline_booking.sql runs in CI and in the migration rehearsal on the host. Not applied to production.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
the restore point is older than one hour, or restore_point / verified_at are still the placeholders
the migration guard raises 55000 (the live engine is not the body it was cut from)
the pgTAP suites record_offline_booking, staff_decide_direct_booking, telegram_inquiry_decisions, inquiry_one_tap and verifier_direct_uid have not passed on this commit
the Opus 5.5 review of this SQL lane has not passed
risks: The engine is patched in place (one predicate). It is inert unless a booking carries an Airbnb block labelled direct whose note names its reference AND the transaction setting names the booking; only record_offline_booking_v1 sets it, and it resets it right after the core call.
record_offline_booking_v1 writes the income row with payment_method null (the contract names none); the ledger shows it as pending_review.
The rollback was not rehearsed (the rehearsal script has no rollback mode) and refuses once a booking carries a channel other than site.
A non-brownout manual calendar row that overlaps is not classified by the contract; the engine reports it as a plain conflict without a reason.
